headline: Nigeria Foreign Exchange Utilisation Surges 78% to Record $7.61 Billion
summary: Nigeria's FX utilisation reached a record $7.61 billion in June 2026, up 78.1% from $4.27 billion a year earlier, driven by increased demand for imported services.
why: Foreign exchange liquidity and utilisation rates heavily influence import costs, external reserves, and currency stabilization in West Africa's largest economy.
